blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Protesters calling for the conviction of Vice President Sara Duterte gathered outside the Senate ahead of Friday’s impeachment trial proceedings. The protesters have been gathering along JW Diokno Boulevard since Sept. 29, but their numbers were noticeably higher on Friday, the 37th day of the trial. READ: VP Trial Day 37: BIR
